certifications.description:
# What is an eco-certified hotel?

This hotel is certified by an independent eco-label. Eco-labels such as Green Key, Green Globe and others assess Accor hotels on sustainable tourism practices.

This certification ensures that the property takes actions to:

- Reduce its environmental impact
- Protect biodiversity around the hotel
- Train its teams on environmental and social issues

Today, more than 3,000 hotels in the group are already certified.
certifications.label: Ecocertified
